files.note: Read the managed Claude account list, the sign-in and its rollback (sealed copy put back, refused credentials deleted, claim_new_folder never reusing a taken id), same_account, remove/unlist, and the per-account pane folder and trust file. Suspected but unproven: claude_account_sign_in marks the sign-in running before app_data_dir() is read, so a failing data folder would leave running set and every later sign-in refused; a Tauri path failure cannot be staged in a unit test, so it is noted, not filed.

Read the hidden setup-token run, the ANSI/CR cleanup, key extraction, the subscription and browser-step conclusions, the cancelled/timed-out endings, the pane environment, and the sealed keep/forget round trip. Only cosmetic: a CRLF in the output becomes two newlines in strip_ansi, which does not change the extracted key. No provable defect.

Read the shared-file copy (newer wins, written beside then moved), the fixed link list and junction creation, the OpenRouter stripping of endpoint and helper settings, and everyday_env. Checked junctions against the skip rule with a scratch probe: a junction reports is_dir/is_file false and is_symlink true, so share_tree skips it as intended. No defect found.

Read the Codex sign-in and its rollback, the private home layout, device-code and email parsing, share_user_files/share_tree/prune_shared, sync_settings_from (the home's trust entries win), remove/unlist, and the settings drift check. F01: sign_in writes HOME_CONFIG over config.toml before the login even for an existing home, so a cancelled or failed re-authentication wipes its settings and project trust, which the code comment and the C25 test say must be kept.

Read the file-write fence: project roots, one-off grants and their persistence, share detection, drive checks and the non-unicode path refusal. Traversal, symlink and junction escapes are covered by the existing tests; the grant store refuses to save over a list it could not keep aside. No provable defect found.

Read the masking passes end to end: provider key shapes, private-key blocks, url credentials, labelled values, headers, env lines, JSON, here-documents, quoted literals, sudo/stdin readers, and the attached short password flag limited to named programs. Probed docker login -p by hand: it is left visible, but the code documents that the attached form belongs only to the listed password programs, so this is scope, not a contradiction. The written cases, digests and idempotence fuzz lock the current behaviour; no provable defect.

Read seal/unseal and the sealed prefix, read/write of vault files, the one-off sealing pass, write_setting and the dropped-key note, clear_setting and the backup rewrite, the store-down refusal, and the Claude key mask used for logs. Existing tests lock the outage, backup and note behaviour; the temporary-file and collision paths are not reachable with the fixed names. No provable defect.

Read the all-or-nothing claude.json and config.toml writers and their baseline check, the backup generation, the Claude and Codex trust entries, the pre-trust that only covers worktrees Kolux made, and the pull-request exclusion. The race tests keep another program's bytes and refuse a changed baseline; no provable defect found.
